messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: PD#987654 - routing-proxy latency > 250ms (threshold: 5m sustained). Auto-page triggered by alert-rule `svc.routing.latency.high`

alex: acked in PD, I'm on it. pulling dashboards now

maria: taking a quick look at egress region metrics, any customer reports?

dan: no support tickets inbound so far, checked status page - all green.

alex: here's the top-level graph — 1m p50 jumping, but p95 and errors flat. looks like a short-lived tail.

sophie: could be autoscaler churn on dedicated pools, saw that earlier today in staging.

alex: running quick query: `sum(rate(router_latency_ms_bucket[1m])) by (le)` — shows spike around 12:01-12:03, then back down.

maria: oncall-prod logs show repeated 503s from a single proxy pod for ~90s, then rotated out. possible probe flakiness.

alex: trying an immediate mitigation — silencing rule for 10m on `svc.routing.latency.high` for region-us-east: `pd silence PD#987654 10m --reason "ephemeral probe flake, investigating"`

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: PD#987654 acknowledged by alex. Silence applied for 10 minutes. (auto-escalation paused)

dan: suggested follow-up: add a narrow suppress condition to avoid full pages on short 1-2min bursts. current rule uses `avg_over_time(<=5m)` which still triggers on short bursts when traffic low.

maria: agree. propose change: require both `p50>200ms` AND `count_over_time(>250ms)[3m] > 100` to reduce noise. will draft query.

alex: quick customer-impact check: cross-region requests show no increase in client-side errors. good — likely internal flake. mark as no-customer-impact.

sophie: adding note: we saw similar pattern last month when a new kernel patch landed on the fleet; operators rolled a small kernel reversion and flares stopped. not sure if related.

maria: drafting alert tweak now. patch proposal in infra-alerts repo: https://git.company/infra-alerts/pulls/342 — includes new `min_hits` gating and lowers sensitivity for low-qps hosts.

alex: nice. for immediate ops, I'll keep the silence until metrics stable for 5m, then un-silence and watch. if it recurs we'll escalate to platform-eng.

incident-bot: Silence expired automatically after 10m. No further pages for PD#987654. Auto-resolve recorded.

dan: follow-up action: schedule a short runbook update and add synthetic canary that exercises probe paths to avoid false positives.

sophie: filing runbook PR now.

alex: summary for post-check: cause = transient proxy probe failure on a single pod; impact = none observed for customers; action = temporary silence, alert rule tightened, runbook + canary follow-up. closing thread unless anyone objects. :white_check_mark:

maria: +1
dan: +1
sophie: +1

(reacted: alex :raised_hands:, maria :thumbsup:, incident-bot :robot_face:)
